content.text: load the library already on init of the component or pretty early in the lifecycle, to prevent long loading times when solving the challenge, as importing may take time. or do you think that importing a chunk is negligebla

Importing one cached chunk is usually modest, but it can be noticeable on slow devices/networks and delays challenge solving. I’ll preload it during component init only when that component’s protection flag is enabled, while retaining a guarded fallback if config arrives later.
